item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las dbang gi sbyin sreg lcags kyu 'bar ba'i phreng ba
item.coloph: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang gi sbyin sreg lcags kyu 'bar ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / snying gi grogs po dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs kyi (kyis) rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo dang / daradakar dri med kyis sna drangs nas bskur (bskul)ba dang / phyis su rang gam gnas pa'i btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs kyi gsang gos dkar po yug ring gis sna drangs nas nye bar bskul ba la bstan (brten) nas/ tshe la dbang thob rig 'dzin nam mkha' sgron gsal gyi rol gar mngon par bstan pa u0f38tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag rang lo sum bcu lon skabs/ rig 'dzin 'di nyid sgrab pa'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) du/ mngon sum zhal gzigs skabs zhal lung gnang bzhin/ lcags bya zla ba'i tshes la spel zhing bsgyur ba'o//
